# mini-repo

Fixture consumer repository for Yama's e2e suites (TASKS:Y8.1). Three source files
and a minimal `.yama/` config directory — enough to drive the config loader, the
capability probe and, later, a local-mode review end to end.

Nothing here is real code; the two `src/` files exist so a diff has something to
point at, and `auth.ts` carries the kind of change a rulebook would have opinions
about.
